description: One of the full-screen screens of Poe's stream overlay (atpota.to/overlay?scene=<record key>): a countdown before a stream, a be-right-back screen, an end screen, or a frame for sharing a screen with a camera. A streamer can keep as many as they like, one record each; the record key is the screen's id in its URL (lowercase letters, digits and dashes). The ones a streamer starts with are keyed by their kind: "starting", "brb", "ending", "screenshare", "loading" and "clock". The overlay reads it from your repo and follows changes live.

kind.description: Which sort of screen it is (loading: Anisota's loading screen, its brand mark with the moon running through its phases, on black; clock: a waiting screen with the time ticking as an atproto TID). Without it, the record key's kind, or starting.

name.description: What the streamer calls this screen ("coding brb"), on the setup page only.

subtitle.description: A line under them: what the stream is about.

background.description: The sky behind it all (the screen share's frame colour).

ground.description: What's along the bottom: a meadow hill with flowers, a strip of grass, soil with sprouts, or nothing.

showWidgets.description: Whether the weather widgets from the overlay's settings show on this scene too.

links.description: Where to find the streamer, on the end screen ("bsky.app/profile/dame.is").

frame.description: The rest of the screen share's frame: how big the screen is, whether the bar with the title shows under it, and which widgets go round it. Without it, a big screen, the bar, and the weather badge under the camera.

size.description: The screen's size on the 1920x1080 canvas: 1440x810, 1280x720 or 1120x630.

words.description: Whether the bar with the title and the line under it shows under the screen.

widgets.description: The overlay's widgets on the frame, each once. They shrink to fit their place.

place.description: Under the screen, or in the column beside it, under the camera.

scale.description: Percent of its usual size, at most.

style.description: How it looks, for a widget with styles, as in to.atpota.poe.overlay.

showMark.description: Whether the atpotato wordmark shows beside the words (on the panel, and in the screen share's bar). Without it, true.

countdown.description: The starting screen's countdown: to a time, or a timer that starts when the scene is shown.

at.description: For a clock: when the stream starts.
